scheme_name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulk Shishyavrutti Yojana
department: Department of Higher and Technical Education, Government of Maharashtra
summary: Fee waiver scheme for economically weaker and reserved-category students pursuing professional courses in Maharashtra.
benefits: Full or partial waiver of tuition and examination fees for eligible professional-course students.
eligibility: Family income below the prescribed limit
Admitted to a recognized professional degree/diploma course
application_steps: Apply through the Mahadbt portal at the time of admission each year
